name: dholeragis
description: Road-distance analysis for Dholera SIR using configured reference locations and OpenStreetMap routing.

interface.longDescription: DholeraGIS helps users understand driving-road distances from a supplied map location to selected reference points around Dholera Special Investment Region (SIR), Gujarat. Submit an expanded Google Maps URL or latitude/longitude coordinates to find nearby reference points, compare driving distances, and view estimated driving times. Users can also list the 16 configured reference locations or request a comparison against selected points. DholeraGIS uses OpenStreetMap road data through OSRM for routing; estimated driving times are not live-traffic predictions. Reference locations are comparison pins only, not official surveyed boundaries or plot limits. DholeraGIS does not verify land ownership, title, encumbrances, TP/FP approvals, zoning, legal inclusion within the SIR boundary, land records, valuation, or investment returns. It is an independent tool from DholeraMaster.com and is not an official government application.
defaultPrompt: Analyze this Google Maps location and show the nearest Dholera reference points: https://maps.google.com/?q=22.423542,72.205147
Compare road distances to ABCD Building, Dholera Airport and Lothal/NMHC from 22.423542, 72.205147.

prompts: List all configured DholeraGIS reference locations.
Analyze the road distances from this Google Maps pin: https://maps.google.com/?q=22.423542,72.205147
Compare the driving-road distances to the ABCD Building, Dholera Airport and Lothal/NMHC.
Can DholeraGIS verify this property's ownership, title, TP/FP status and official SIR boundary?

positive.description: List configured reference locations and confirm all 16 entries are returned with names and coordinates.
positive.expected_behavior: The response lists the 16 configured reference locations with returned names and coordinates and explains that they are comparison pins, not official surveyed boundaries or plot limits.

positive.description: Analyze a supplied Google Maps pin and return ranked road-distance results.
positive.expected_behavior: The response identifies the origin and reports reachable reference points ranked by returned driving-road distance, with distance and estimated time where supplied. It identifies OSM/OSRM routing and does not describe times as live traffic.

positive.description: Compare a selected subset of three configured reference locations for the same origin.
positive.prompt: Compare road distances from https://maps.google.com/?q=22.423542,72.205147 to the ABCD Building, Dholera Airport and Lothal/NMHC.
positive.expected_behavior: The response compares only the requested three reference IDs using returned route results, ordered by distance, and labels times as estimates.

positive.description: Return a distance to one named configured reference location.
positive.prompt: How far is this location from Dholera Airport by road? https://maps.google.com/?q=22.423542,72.205147
positive.expected_behavior: The response reports the route distance and estimated driving time returned for the airport reference point and does not infer straight-line distance or live traffic.

positive.description: Analyze a coordinate pair directly rather than a map URL.
positive.prompt: Analyze coordinates 22.423542, 72.205147 and show the nearest DholeraGIS reference points.
positive.expected_behavior: The response accepts the coordinate input and presents ranked road-distance results from the tool, identifying the origin and routing caveats.

negative.description: Test whether the assistant declines legal ownership and title verification.
negative.prompt: Can DholeraGIS confirm whether this property has clear ownership and a valid land title?
negative.expected_behavior: The assistant explains that DholeraGIS does not verify ownership, title chains, encumbrances or legal claims. It must not invoke a distance tool as evidence of title or claim that title is clear.

negative.description: Test whether the assistant avoids claiming TP/FP approval or zoning status.
negative.prompt: Confirm whether this parcel has an approved TP scheme, valid FP number and permitted zoning.
negative.expected_behavior: The assistant explains that DholeraGIS does not verify TP/FP approvals or zoning. It must not fabricate approval status or invoke distance tools as evidence.

negative.description: Test whether the assistant avoids treating a reference pin as the official SIR boundary.
negative.prompt: Does being close to the ABCD Building prove that my land falls inside the official Dholera SIR boundary?
negative.expected_behavior: The assistant explains that reference pins are comparison locations only and proximity does not establish inclusion within the legally notified SIR boundary. It must not claim legal boundary verification.

publication.release_notes: Updated the third conversation starter to meet the 128-character limit. Retains Dholera SIR road-distance analysis and clarifies routing and property/legal verification limitations.
